chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That he disliked eating every creature with a shell.

key_terms.ذِي حُمَةٍ: Creature with a shell (e.g., crab, lobster, turtle)
key_terms.كَرِهَ: Disliked (indicating recommended avoidance or mild prohibition in fiqh)

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on eating shellfish according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expresses *karahah* (dislike/preference) for consuming any creature possessing a shell (*hummah*), a ruling that informs the Shia jurisprudential debate on the permissibility of shellfish. This narration highlights the distinction between absolute prohibition (*haram*) and recommended dislike (*mustahabb* or *makruh*), reflecting the nuanced approach of the Imams to dietary laws derived from the Quran and Sunnah.
